content: We just moved into the old lighthouse on the coast, and I miss my sister Rina already.
The lighthouse must be beautiful at night. Does Rina visit often?
Not really, she lives three towns over and works nights at the hospital.
I remember when the sea spirits still guided every fishing boat safely home.
Ha, no sea spirits here, just gulls and fog and my bad sense of direction.
He left his old journal on the porch again last night.
Sounds like Wren stopped by. He always forgets that journal.
I promise I will never lie to you, no matter what happens.
I will remember that promise always, for as long as we are together.
The old lighthouse keeper's ghost still walks these halls every midnight.
I don't believe in ghosts, but the wind through the tower does sound like footsteps.
Maybe it is just the wind. Or maybe the keeper is still watching over the light.
Hey, this is Vex checking in from the other room, everything okay over there?
We're fine, Vex, just talking about the lighthouse and old stories.
Let me know if you two need anything, I will be down the hall.
Thanks, Vex. We're just settling in for the night.
Today felt like the first day this place actually started to feel like home.
I'm glad. I want this to feel like home for you too.
Rina says she might visit next month if her shifts line up.
I would love to finally meet her in person.
